data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded favourable prior-year reserve development in 2022, with a reassessment of previous accident years producing a net surplus of GBP 30.83m (a release). The report also notes prior year reserve releases on the 2019 and earlier years contributing GBP 27.6m to underwriting profit, predominantly in Property and Motor. Current-year catastrophe activity (Hurricane Ian, Winter Storm Elliot, Sydney Floods) and provisions relating to the Russian invasion of Ukraine increased claims pressure in 2022, but the prior-year movements were overall favourable.
raw_causal_phrases: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 30,830,000 (2021: surplus of GBP 16,021,000) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.
Prior year reserve releases on the 2019 and prior years of account contributed GBP 27.6 million to underwriting profit (2021: GBP 17.3 million), predominantly across the Property & Motor division.

The net claims ratio of 47.9% is higher than prior year (36.7%) driven by catastrophe losses. This year the Syndicate was impacted by provisions for potential exposures arising from the Ukraine War, in addition to Hurricane Ian, Winter Storm Elliot and Sydney Floods.

data.data_quality_notes: A gross prior-year movement figure was not explicitly provided. The report explicitly states a net prior-year reassessment surplus of GBP 30.83m; gross-specific prior-year movement was not found in a single gross-number movement line. The return therefore uses the explicit NET prior-year surplus as a fallback (flagged). The report does include a gross claims development table (page 33) which could be used to derive a gross PYD but the table formatting in the source made reliable automated extraction/calculation uncertain; users should treat the gross/net distinction carefully. Also the report quantifies prior-year reserve releases on 2019 and prior years as GBP 27.6m (statement appears net of reinsurance) which has been recorded as a prior_year_event. Where gross figures were not clearly stated, amounts have been left null and confidence reduced.
